question: Add a new method ExplainQuery(ctx context.Context, qs string) (*QueryPlan, error) to the QueryEngine interface in promql. QueryEngine is used by Thanos query frontend for distributed PromQL evaluation and by Grafana for direct Prometheus queries. All implementations must add this method.

downstream_consumers_affected.description: Thanos QueryFactory — wraps promql.Engine for local/distributed query modes
downstream_consumers_affected.details: QueryFactory holds a `*promql.Engine` (field `prometheus` at line 80) and delegates to it. It does NOT directly implement the QueryEngine interface, but it wraps `promql.Engine` which will gain the new method. The Thanos remote engine (`remoteEngine` in pkg/query/remote_engine.go) has its own query interface and would need separate consideration if it needs ExplainQuery capability.
downstream_consumers_affected.action: No direct code change needed since QueryFactory uses the concrete *promql.Engine which will automatically gain the method. However, if QueryFactory's `queryCreator` interface needs to expose query explanation, a `makeExplainQuery` method would need to be added.

answer.summary: The QueryEngine interface is defined in prometheus/prometheus at promql/engine.go:125-128. Adding ExplainQuery requires: (1) Define a new QueryPlan struct in the promql package, (2) Add the ExplainQuery method to the QueryEngine interface, (3) Implement it on the concrete Engine struct (promql/engine.go:345), (4) Implement it on the fakeEngine test mock (web/api/v1/api_test.go:4892). Downstream consumers in Thanos and the Prometheus web/rules/test layers primarily use the concrete *promql.Engine type or only call existing methods, so they require no code changes for compilation. An optional new API endpoint could be added to expose the functionality over HTTP.
